messages:
sophie (sales): Hey team — running a demo with PayCo and they hit a bunch of 429s after ~10 mins. They’re using embeddings route + production client. They say tokens/sec jumps during batch ingest. Can we triage?

ravi (eng): what exact 429? per-route or tenant? Any example request IDs?

sophie (sales): log snippet from PayCo attached: ```429 ERROR route=embed-256 tenant=payco req_id=01F8ZK8 token_count=4500 burst_window=60``` They said their client batches 2500 texts in parallel.

josh (sre): looks like per-route cap (default 200 rps) + token budget. If they send big concurrent batches tokens spike -> token-based throttling. Can you get the app's per-request token avg?

sophie (sales): they estimate ~18 tokens per short text => ~45k tokens/s during peak.

ravi (eng): that will blow past their token budget and per-route burst. Options: increase per-route burst for demo, enable client-side backoff, or route to a higher-cap model. Which is easiest for POC?

maria (acct): Finance question from PayCo: will we bill for the extra tokens during the temporary bump? They’re sensitive to unexpected cost.

ravi (eng): we can enable a time-limited quota bump for demo (10x burst for 1 hour) — we don't auto-bill; usage will be recorded. Sales should confirm they accept billed usage. Also suggest sampling/compaction to reduce tokens.

sophie (sales): ok please do the temp bump now. I'll confirm billing. @ravi can you toggle?

ravi (eng): doing it now — applied per-route burst increase for tenant=payco on embed-256: burst_window=60 -> 600, token_budget=500000. Monitor logs.

deploy-bot: rolling update: quota-bump-payco applied by ravi at 2141599302 :white_check_mark:

josh (sre): monitoring — no 429s in the last 3m. CPU on dedicated pool spiked 20% but ok. :thumbsup:

maria (acct): PayCo approved billed usage for the demo. Billing note: flag as POC discount negotiable. I'll attach the pricing note in the ticket.

sophie (sales): awesome — PayCo confirms demo resumed and saw expected throughput. Closing loop later with a recommended production config.

ravi (eng): follow-ups: add client-side retry guidance to the POC runbook, and include token budgeting examples. I'll drop a short snippet:

```js
// exponential backoff pseudo
for (let i=0;i<5;i++){ try { await sendBatch() ; break } catch(e){ await sleep(2**i * 100) }}
```

sophie (sales): perfect. thanks all! :tada:
